name: magnesium carbonate + passiflora incarnata flower + valerian
purpose: For Relief of Muscle Spasms Tension and Stress
uses: INDICATIONS: For temporary relief of muscle spasms, tension and stress.
otcwarn: Warning: Do not give to children under twelve except under the advice and supervision of a doctor. If you are pregnant or nursing a baby seek the advice of a health professional before using this product. Do not exceed recommended dosage. Consult a doctor if symptoms are more than mild or if they persist.
